title: Vincenzo I Gonzaga, Duke of Mantua, to Louis de Gonzague, duc de Nevers, 17 Sept 1590 (BnF fr. 3979 ff. 92-93, DECODE R4176)

documents.shelfmark: BnF, Français 3979, ff. 92r-93r (DECODE R4176, images P1-P14)
documents.route: Mantua -> Louis de Gonzague, duc de Nevers (France)

plaintext.source: No contemporary decipherment on the record; not deciphered in print or online (DECODE Non-decrypted; Tomokiyo lists the key only).

transcription.source: DECODE R4176 high-resolution strips, read at 3x; f. 92r by the main session, ff. 92v and 93r by two subagents
transcription.notes: Unseparated two-digit figures. Counted as digits/2 plus signs over the non-comment lines (943; the blot not counted); _check_profile --measure splits on spaces and does not fit this format. reading.md's table gives 945. Files: ct_92r.txt, ct_92v.txt, ct_93r.txt (ct.txt a combined working copy).

system.summary: Two-digit figures written unseparated: 11-40 letters with homophones, 41-99 words and names, plus overbarred figures and signs for titles and common words (Tomokiyo's Nevers no. 35, BnF fr. 3995 f. 64).
system.notes: An overbar on a letter figure doubles it. Hand traps: 3/9, 0/8, 7/8 and 27/28 look alike.

prior_solution.where: checked DECODE R4176 (Non-decrypted) and Tomokiyo cryptiana nevers.htm (key listed, letter not deciphered)

conditions.human_role: Project-level: set up Claude Code with Opus 5 and posed the problem. No target-specific intervention recorded.
tools: python beam decoder with the lang/ it-cinquecento model (beam.py, dec.py)

solution.what: Tomokiyo nevers.htm and the DECODE record checked for a decipherment of R4176.
DECODE R4176 images P1-P14 downloaded with the session cookie.
Tomokiyo's Nevers cipher no. 35, described as used by the Duke of Mantua in 1590, traced to BnF fr. 3995 f. 64 'Per Cavare 1590' (Gallica btv1b525085665 canvas 131) and read.
Unseparated two-digit figures transcribed from the images: f. 92r in the main session, ff. 92v and 93r by two subagents.
Key applied unchanged; Italian reads at once on f. 92r (la morte del Papa sia stata procurata con veleno da Spagnoli).
Beam decoder with the it-cinquecento LM resolving 3/9 and 0/8 look-alikes, then 7/8 added; f. 93r reads through.
Sign and title values (che, per, et, S. M.ta, Legato, Monsignor ...) read from the key sheet and substituted.
Retry pass: a subagent re-read the doubtful lines at 3x; about 829 of 945 tokens now read (88%); garbled stretches on f. 92r and f. 93r and three signs absent from the key remain.

outcome.fraction_read_source: gonzaga1590/reading.md token table (cipher tokens; [..] stretches counted as unread, lengths estimated)
outcome.notes: Archive key applied unchanged; Mantua on the rumoured poisoning of Sixtus V by the Spaniards and his devotion to the French crown.

gaps.detail: writer's slips; not fixed by the look-alike alternatives

gaps.detail: each once, not on fr. 3995 f. 64
